gates: Never clear the original dirty flag
A clean replacement is a different candidate and cannot close this original artifact by substitution
required_inputs: Exact published dirty bytes and complete delta against the recorded base
Grant/notice provenance covering base and every changed contribution

gates: No SPDX-only or substituted canonical template
Retain every applicable condition and distinct required notice
Keep source-code license owners distinct from owners of license text itself
required_inputs: Complete actual selected license grant/conditions/disclaimers and package ancestor or explicit project application proof

gates: No metadata declaration alone becomes a package-source proof
Keep absent VCS path distinct from a proved root path
Reject dirty/version/body mismatches rather than selecting a convenient revision
required_inputs: Exact original manifest Git blob at the recorded source path/revision
Exact literal version or proved governing workspace version

gates: An absent original manifest is not a truncated one: request provenance, not a fabricated hash
Full hash and prefix must both match before parsing/replacing the in-memory view
Frozen private capture remains unchanged
required_inputs: Complete original manifest bytes matching the retained full hash and captured prefix when available
original_manifest.supplier: exact-version published source or retained indexed metadata

gates: No authors, equal license bodies, Apache placeholders, or source-file notice promoted to a whole package
Keep code and supplemental notice revisions distinct; any supplemental attestation must explicitly identify the old snapshot and receive scope review
Do not refetch already-retained root templates hoping for different names; a new scoped input is required
required_inputs: Actual named copyright/NOTICE evidence and exact package/project scope
Exact notice-source URL/revision/body hash and grant-source relationship

gates: Every generated manifest must match its retained full SHA-256
Do not assume ra-ap manifests equal rustc manifests
Current publisher head/tag or common version does not replace missing transformation/VCS proof
required_inputs: Immutable publisher script/revision and release record for 0.166.0
Deterministic generated manifest/source mapping from declared Rust commit ce89c898570852a1bb441d77570596e50bf362c2 to the exact retained generated package

gates: Preserve the retained Apple SDK distribution uncertainty
Do not infer permission or ownership from framework/author/company names
Do not automatically assign this SDK finding to the five core objc runtime crates
required_inputs: Exact source/SDK derivation and applicable grant/notice scope for framework code
Complete actual package grant and attribution; SPDX overview links alone are insufficient

gates: No guessed repository, tag/head, or revision correction
README project links alone and equal license bodies do not establish lineage
A prior HTTP failure is historical evidence, not proof that no source exists
SATISFIED here means the narrow VCS input is available; canonical repository and package manifest correspondence still require their separate gates
required_inputs: Retained exact package VCS declaration or authoritative equivalent when that record is absent/failed
Same retained package artifact/checksum and manifest/source correspondence; retained VCS availability alone does not discharge manifest/workspace gates

gates: Match all manifest Git blobs and package identity
Retain already-satisfied version proofs for the three recorded wasm cases
An inherited declaration is not proof its value is unresolved if a current exact proof already exists
required_inputs: Governing Cargo.toml at the recorded revision, evidenced explicit/implicit path membership and exclusions, and inherited values
Proof no nearer workspace overrides the governing metadata
